commands.name: CancelTaskWithoutExecution
input: execution_revision: int>=0 where 0 means exact execution history/projection absence
outcome_revision: int=0 meaning exact task_outcome_current and task_outcome_events absence
steps: pure-preflight validates UUID/revision/time/reason shape

inside one writer UoW load exact Task; require task_revision exact; reconcile execution authority so revision 0 means exact no-history absence while a positive revision may legitimately fold to logical not_started after corrections; mismatch returns TASK_STALE
require outcome_revision=0 and exact absence of both task_outcome_current and owned outcome history; any history/current mismatch fails closed and any accepted outcome blocks cancellation

require current-effective execution state not_started with no accepted start and no terminal execution; a current-effective start returns TASK_CANCEL_AFTER_START and existing terminal authority returns TASK_EXECUTION_ALREADY_TERMINAL before receipt

insert one receipt, append one manual_cancel execution event at prior execution revision+1 using effective_cancel_utc, rebuild execution projection to terminated, and append the first outcome event cancelled_without_execution with correction_of_event_id null

create task_outcome_current at revision 1, resolve reviewed_at_utc once from server canonical recording time, increment tasks.revision exactly once, and do not alter provider WFM status/source evidence

rebuild affected Objective aggregate, append one task.execution_changed.v1 audit entry for the manual_cancel event and one task.outcome_reviewed.v1 entry for the cancelled outcome under the same receipt, using the canonical COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 request_hash as the latter audit review_fingerprint because this command has no separate preview; commit exact immutable response atomically
rules: pristine execution revision 0 and corrected positive-revision logical not_started are distinct freshness authorities and both are revalidated exactly
effective cancellation time and outcome reviewed/recording time are distinct
execution chronology remains the contiguous execution_revision chain
cancellation never rewrites provider status or prior evidence and cannot proceed when any outcome history already exists

CancelTaskWithoutExecution introduces no bespoke review-fingerprint format; its exact command request hash already binds Task/execution/outcome-absence freshness, effective cancellation time and reason for bounded audit correlation

commands.name: ReviewTaskOutcome
input: outcome_revision: int>=0 where 0 means exact outcome history/current absence
current_outcome_event_id: canonical UUIDv4 iff outcome_revision>0, else null
reason_category: bounded code or null according to acceptance matrix
steps: pure-preflight validates identifiers/revisions/outcome/reason/fingerprint without reading owner state

inside one writer UoW load exact Task, fold contiguous execution history, and reconcile exact outcome absence or positive linear outcome chain/current pointer; because this mutation consumes a reviewed preview, any task_revision/execution_revision/outcome revision/current-event drift from those reviewed inputs returns TASK_REVIEW_STALE before receipt, while integrity disagreement fails closed; TASK_STALE remains the ordinary freshness error for non-preview-bound Task mutations
recompute SOMA_TASK_OUTCOME_REVIEW_V1 from current owner authority and exact request and require fingerprint equality before receipt

validate requested outcome against current corrected execution: completed requires ended with accepted start/end; incomplete requires accepted start and ended or terminated plus reason when evidence does not explain incompleteness; cancelled_without_execution requires no current-effective accepted start and terminated evidence

if a current reviewed outcome exists, return semantic NO_CHANGE only when it remains valid and requested outcome plus normalized reason exactly equal the current event under the exact fingerprint; any different current reviewed outcome is not overwritten and requires CorrectTaskOutcome

for material first review, insert one receipt, resolve reviewed_at_utc once from server canonical recording time, append one outcome event with correction_of_event_id null, create task_outcome_current revision 1, and increment tasks.revision exactly once; execution revision/history are unchanged
rebuild affected Objective aggregate/current-review validity, append one task.outcome_reviewed.v1 audit event and commit exact immutable response atomically
rules: reviewed_at is acceptance/recording time and never substitutes for actual execution occurrence
NO_CHANGE creates no outcome history, Task revision increment or fake audit; exact replay still returns the immutable original command result
review fingerprint is evidence of the exact reviewed state and never replaces writer-UoW revalidation

commands.name: CorrectTaskOutcome
input: reason_category: bounded code or null according to acceptance matrix
steps: pure-preflight validates identifiers/revisions/outcome/reason/fingerprint without reading owner state

inside one writer UoW load exact Task/execution authority and reconcile positive outcome history/current projection as one linear append-only chain; because this mutation consumes a reviewed preview, any task_revision/execution_revision/current_outcome_revision/current_outcome_event_id drift from those reviewed inputs returns TASK_REVIEW_STALE before receipt; current outcome revision must equal event count/chain length and the event id must be its exact tip, with integrity disagreement failing closed; TASK_STALE remains the ordinary freshness error for non-preview-bound Task mutations

recompute SOMA_TASK_OUTCOME_CORRECTION_REVIEW_V1 from current authority and exact request and require fingerprint equality before receipt; any execution/current-outcome drift returns TASK_REVIEW_STALE
validate replacement against current corrected execution using the same Task outcome acceptance matrix; do not trust client-computed state
if replacement outcome plus normalized reason exactly equal the current event under the exact fingerprint, return semantic NO_CHANGE without appending history/revisions/audit

otherwise insert one receipt, resolve reviewed_at_utc once from server canonical recording time, append exactly one outcome event whose correction_of_event_id equals the exact prior current tip, advance task_outcome_current revision exactly once, and increment tasks.revision exactly once; prior outcome rows remain immutable
rebuild affected Objective aggregate and invalidate any Objective review whose fingerprint changed; append one task.outcome_reviewed.v1 audit event and commit exact immutable response atomically
rules: same Task attempt/execution history survives; retry is a separate command
outcome correction is linear append-only authority and never branches from a non-current event
reviewed_at/UUID order never determines outcome correction chronology; current chain tip plus current outcome revision do
